title: Kanlaon emits ash 4 times, triggers ashfall in Negros Occidental

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY—Four ash emissions from Kanlaon Volcano on Sunday, Nov. 15, triggered ashfall in parts of La Carlota City and La Castellana in Negros Occidental, the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) reported.
